description: Fail-closed path crashes on corrupt signal artifacts: cf_signal=None passes key-presence .get() then float(None) raises TypeError; mixed-type model_version/data_version raise TypeError in sorted() during diagnostics build. validate_signals correctly rejects these artifacts but the fallback diagnostics builder itself raises, so the caller gets an exception instead of the contractually guaranteed original safe ordering (violates audit contract section 15 'No crash' for corrupt artifacts).
risk: A future non-neutral provider emitting a malformed artifact would crash the Personal/Agentic ranking pipeline instead of degrading to original order. Not reachable with current production defaults (provider=None strict no-op; neutral_cf_provider well-formed) and does not touch the external formal evaluator or formal-run inputs.
evidence: Synthetic repro executed 2026-08-18 against frozen SHA 71f8b67ae3e0a661894d44e50b887c3b4676a2b3f1c28e524eef92a52665c835: (1) signals={'t1':{'cf_signal':None}} -> TypeError: float() argument must be a string or a real number, not 'NoneType'; (2) two tasks with model_version 5 vs 'v1' -> TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'str' and 'int'. Both triggered inside _diagnostics after validate_signals returned False.
status: OPEN (repair ticket required; blocks READY_FOR_FORMAL_RUN per section 23)
